consent.title: {app} wants to connect to your Plane account
consent.description: If you allow this, {app} can act for you in Plane, but only within the access listed below.
consent.warning_title: Only allow this if you started it yourself
consent.warning_description: Check that the account below is yours and that you asked {app} to connect just now. If someone else sent you this link, choose Cancel.
consent.plane_account_help: The app will act for you as this account.
consent.revoke_hint: You can take this access back at any time in your profile settings, under Connected apps.
consent.expired_description: A link to connect an app works once and only for a few minutes. Go back to the app and ask for a new one.
consent.error_description: The request could not be completed. Try again, or ask the app for a new link.
consent.framed_title: Open this page on its own
consent.framed_description: For your safety, this page does not work inside another page. Open it in a new tab to continue.

connected_apps.title: Connected apps
connected_apps.description: Apps you have allowed to act for you in Plane. Remove any you no longer use.
connected_apps.revoke_description: {app} will stop working immediately. You can connect it again later.

revoke_success.title: Access revoked
revoke_success.message: {app} can no longer act for you.

revoke_error.title: Could not revoke access
revoke_error.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

empty.title: No connected apps
empty.description: When you connect an app to your Plane account, it appears here.

load_error.title: Could not load your connected apps
load_error.description: Check your connection and try again.

profile.title: Your name and workspaces
profile.description: Your name, your time zone and the workspaces you belong to.

time_read.title: Your working days and time
time_read.description: Whether each day is a working day, a public holiday or a day off for you, the hours you have worked, and the work item your timer is running on.

leave_read.title: Your leave
leave_read.description: Your leave balance, and the kind of absence (for example holiday or sick leave) booked on a day off.

work_items_read.title: Your projects and work items
work_items_read.description: The projects you are a member of and the work items you can see in them, with their comments.
